platforms.role: Next.js presentation, workspace and same-origin API proxy
platforms.secretRule: No AWS or Supabase service-role credentials in NEXT_PUBLIC variables

platforms.role: Three independent Node services: central API plus hospital A and B
operatorActions: Set each actual hospital HTTPS URL on central API
Set APP_ORIGINS to actual Next.js origin
Review three paid plans and persistent disks before deploying
Use strong per-hospital keys and protect administrator endpoints

platforms.role: User identity and central application state
platforms.authorization: JWT identity and active membership plus live patient consent; service-role keys are backend-only

platforms.role: Private encrypted synthetic source snapshots, normalized FHIR and indexed evidence
platforms.encryption: SSE-KMS preferred; explicit AES256 supported for separately configured demo buckets

platforms.role: Semantic retrieval of normalized evidence documents
platforms.readiness: Data source AVAILABLE and ingestion COMPLETE required; configuration alone does not establish readiness
security: Live server-side identity and consent before retrieval
AND patient, hospital, authorized record and category filters
Recheck permissions again before releasing generated answer

platforms.role: Converse generation using authorized retrieved evidence
platforms.security: Explicit output tokens, document instructions treated as untrusted, JSON/citation membership validation; clinician review still required

platforms.role: Browser recognition and synthesis where supported

setupSequence: Deploy storage-stack.json manually with IAM capability; retain output bucket/key/connector-role identifiers
Set explicit AWS configuration and BEDROCK_KB_ROLE_ARN
Run aws:kb create --apply only after AWS_PROVISIONING_ENABLED=true
Check aws:kb status until ACTIVE; save BEDROCK_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_ID
Generate local sample files with seed:samples; optionally upload with --upload --apply
Run aws:kb ingest --apply and check ingestion-status until COMPLETE
Render exact runtime policy, attach to the actual API runtime identity and tighten connector role trust to the created KB ARN
Configure CloudTrail knowledge-base data-event selection explicitly
Configure Supabase project and Render services, then set Vercel API_PROXY_TARGET and redeploy
A hosted system is not claimed complete until the actual configured services have been exercised
